messages:
mike: quick question — thinking about a console affordance for delegating scoped permissions to tenant admins. do we expose route-level presets or let customers author arbitrary scope expressions?
olga: leaning toward presets + custom. presets reduce mistakes and simplify telemetry/rollout telemetry. can you sketch the UX?
sarah: presets sound good but we need an escape hatch for integrations. maybe presets + an ‘advanced expression’ modal with validation and preview.
jun: +1. also need to consider quota routing policies — if a tenant admin can bind a route they shouldn't bypass global quotas or routing tiers. enforcement should be server-side.
mike: yep enforcement server-side. UX where tenant admin selects a preset (or advanced) and a checkbox "respect org-level quotas & routing" (locked for non-enterprise?). mock:
```yaml
preset: manage-routes
allowed_routes: ["/generate","/chat/*"]
actions: [create, update, attach-policy]
respect_org_quota: true
```
toni: small ask: show effective permissions preview in the modal (what the preset enables + what org policies still restrict). that prevents surprise escalations.
devex: can we add a copyable policy snippet for infra (so infra can code-review tenant changes)?
mike: yes — export as JSON policy and show diffs. also thinking about telemetry: we tag all route changes with actor, preset-id, audit-hash. rollouts dashboard can surface spikes when new presets are delegated.
olga: question about versioning: if we update a preset, should it apply retrospectively to tenants who selected it? i think no — preset updates should be opt-in, with a banner in console.
sarah: opt-in + automated migration tooling for security fixes (force update for critical CVE/policy).
jun: on API side, introduce a "delegated_binding" resource with fields: tenant_id, preset_id, custom_expression(optional), created_by, applied_preset_version, enforcement_flags. something like:
```json
{"tenant_id":"t-123","preset_id":"manage-routes-v1","custom_expression":null,"created_by":"mike","applied_preset_version":"v1","enforcement_flags":{"respect_org_quota":true}}
```
mike: that fits. but keep scope expressions small — no regex for routes, just glob patterns. regexs are maintenance burden.
toni: UX detail: when tenant admin opens "add delegate" flow, show a small inline warning if their choice could increase cost (e.g., enabling high-throughput route). show estimated token/throughput delta.
devex: we should add a short onboarding tooltip and API sample for partners too.
deploy-bot: mock uploaded: https://redwood/internal/mock/2145673210 (ui -> delegates -> preset-flow) :white_check_mark:
mike: next steps: i'll draft the preset schema and open a PR for API shape + DB migration. olga — can you own the console mock? sarah — can you file ux copy for the banners and migration CTA?
olga: yep, will start a figma screen and link here.
sarah: will write copy. adding notes for legal around audit-retention defaults.
jun: i'll add server-side quota check and a unit test matrix for enforced vs delegated scopes.
mike: thanks all. follow-up sync in tomorrow eng-platform standup. :thumbsup:
